'''Bettina''' is a character in the [[Grand Theft Auto]] series who appears as a minor character in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]. She is voiced by [[Noelle Sadler]].

==Character history==
Bettina, at an unknown time, turned to a life of [[Prostitutes|prostitution]] and began to work for [[Jizzy B.]], a [[Jizzy's Pleasure Domes|club]] owner and the biggest pimp in [[San Fierro]]. In [[1992]], shortly before Jizzy's death, she is seen [[Ice Cold Killa|taking abuse]] from him after asking for a greater cut of the money made by the [[Loco Syndicate]].
